tables.name: Administration District Additional Locations
tables.description: Rolled for each additional location of a Administration district (Very Small 1 … Very Large 5 per district). 1 and 20: roll again, the next location a step down or up in quality.

results.name: Roll Again (a step down in quality)
results.description: Roll again, but consider the next location to be a step down in quality.

results.name: Baker
results.description: (Basic) Bakes and sells fresh bread and, possibly, pastries.

results.name: Tailor
results.description: (Basic) Makes and sells clothing, including hats and cloaks. Also sells general items made from cloth, such as blankets, and carries out repairs and alterations of cloth goods.

results.name: Alchemist
results.description: (Specialty) Brews and sells potions, as well as mundane herbs and alchemical ingredients.

results.name: Cobbler
results.description: (Specialty) Makes and mends boots and shoes.

results.name: Luxury Furnishings
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells all manner of home items for fine living, including furniture, art, and other high-quality goods.

results.name: Rare Libations & Fare
results.description: (Exotic) Sells (and, perhaps, makes or brews) drinks and/or food of surpassing quality or rarity to the region.

results.name: Barber
results.description: Provides grooming services, such as haircuts or shaves.

results.name: Bathhouse
results.description: Provides spaces for bathing.

results.name: Doctor/Apothecary
results.description: Provides medical care.

results.name: House of Leisure
results.description: Provides entertainment and/or relaxation (GM may decide what kind).

results.name: Inn
results.description: Provides accommodation, as well as a place to have a bath and a decent meal.

results.name: Club
results.description: Provides entertainment via comedic, dramatic or musical performance.

results.name: Tavern
results.description: Provides food and drink.

results.name: Hired Help
results.description: Hired help; its kind is rolled (1d10), then its size.

results.name: Archives/Library
results.description: (Non-commercial) A structure devoted to housing records and written information.

results.name: Academy/University
results.description: (Non-commercial) A conservatory devoted to the pursuit of higher knowledge, sometimes of a specific area of study.

results.name: Schoolhouse
results.description: (Non-commercial) An institution focused on educating children.

results.name: Amphitheater
results.description: (Non-commercial) Outdoor space with a stage and tiered seating.

results.name: Roll Again (a step up in quality)
results.description: Roll again, but consider the next location to be a step up in quality.
